headline: Saber denies replacing Rideshare Stimulator's writers with ChatGPT
summary: Saber CEO denies replacing writers with ChatGPT for "Rideshare Stimulator." Former lead writer, Stella Sacco, claims she was replaced by AI. Controversy erupts over AI use in game development.

headline: Xbox Elite 3 prototype pad leaks with tiny built-in screen
summary: A prototype Xbox Elite Series 3 controller has reportedly leaked. The pad features a distinctive tiny built-in screen. A Redditor claims to have purchased the unreleased controller for $200.

headline: An FCC filing points to new Sonos headphones coming soon
summary: New Sonos wireless headphones are expected to launch this fall. An FCC filing by Sonos, Inc. reveals details for model number S52A. The release follows hints from CEO Tom Conrad during an earnings call.

headline: ChatGPT and Gemini both just passed 1 billion users
summary: ChatGPT and Google Gemini have both surpassed 1 billion users. Gemini is Google's fastest-growing product ever, reaching the milestone quickly. This marks a significant growth achievement for leading AI applications.

headline: Zack Snyder Returns to Warner Bros. Lot Years After DCEU Exit
summary: Zack Snyder made a surprise visit to the Warner Bros. lot. This marks his return years after his contentious DCEU exit. The visit fuels speculation about his future projects with the studio.

headline: Woman assaulted by double murderer says nightmare became 'real life' when police let him attack again
summary: Victim of double murderer Simon Levy recounts police failures. Levy, a serial sex offender, was allowed to re-offend despite past assaults. His release led to the murder of two women and the rape of another.

headline: More weather records as UK heat set to spike again
summary: The UK is experiencing another significant heat spike. Summer's record for days above 30C has been broken again. New weather records continue to fall across the country.

headline: Police chiefs call for PM to prevent early release of PC Harper's killers
summary: Police chiefs urge the Prime Minister to block the early release of PC Harper's killers. The intervention follows Andy Burnham's confidence in preventing their release. The move aims to ensure justice for the fallen officer.

headline: UK to get best eclipse since 1999 as Moon blocks out Sun across Europe
summary: The UK anticipates its most significant eclipse since 1999. Up to 96% of the Sun will be obscured by the Moon. A total solar eclipse will be visible across parts of Europe, including Spain and Iceland.
